messages:
Priya: Huge thanks to Lina and Marco for running the mentorship hour and the onboarding hangout today — so many great questions answered. :tada: Love the follow-up doc too!

Sam: +1 that was great. A few folks said it helped clear up the release flow.

Lina: Thanks!! Glad it helped. Shoutout to @Avery for the slides and @Marco for staying after to pair on the infra bits. :heart: 

Marco: had fun — also grabbed boba on my way back and left them in kitchen for the crew (cold ones in fridge). :bubble_tea: 

Avery: Slides linked here: https://redwood-internal.example.com/mentorship/4 — feel free to copy. Also can spin up a recurring slot next week?

Priya: yes pls. recurring would be amazing. People who want to mentor next week?

Sam: I can do Wed afternoon. Also, can we do a tiny thank-you treat tomorrow? Cake? Poll: `/poll "Cake flavor?" "Chocolate" "Matcha" "Lemon" "No cake, just stickers"`

Lina: Matcha please. :green_heart: 

people-ops: Love this — we can reimburse small office treats. Ping us with receipt. :receipt: 

Avery: I'll run the poll in #random. Also added a one-line doc snippet for onboarding checklist:

```
- Welcome + intros (5m)
- Product tour (10m)
- Quick infra walkthrough (10m)
- Q&A + pairing signups (15m)
```

Marco: Also made a tiny GIF for the recap: https://gifs.example.com/thank-you-lina-marco.gif :sparkles: 

gratitude-bot: Automated note: Lina and Marco received 12 kudos reactions in the past 24h. :star2: 

Priya: ok that's it — big thanks again. If anyone wants to mentor next week add yourself to the doc. :raised_hands:
